classification.difficultyReason: Connect a polynomial tangent with its intercepts, a sketch, distance and triangular area.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the equation of the tangent to $f(x)=10x-x^3$ at the point $P(2,12)$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the points $A$ and $B$ where the tangent meets the $x$-axis and $y$-axis respectively.

answer.worked:
At the $x$-intercept, $y=0$:
$$\begin{align*}0&=-2x+16\\x&=8\end{align*}$$
Thus $A=(8,0)$.

At the $y$-intercept, $x=0$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=-2(0)+16\\y&=16\end{align*}$$
Thus $B=(0,16)$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Sketch the situation, then find the length of $AB$ and the area of $\triangle OAB$.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}AB&=\sqrt{(8-0)^2+(0-16)^2}\\AB&=\sqrt{320}\\AB&=8\sqrt5\text{ units}\end{align*}$$
The coordinate axes are perpendicular, so $OA=8$ and $OB=16$ are the base and height.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Area of }\triangle OAB&=\tfrac12(8)(16)\\\text{Area of }\triangle OAB&=64\text{ square units}\end{align*}$$
